Name: confluence
Description: Search pages in the allowed spaces and read a page as text. Read only.

Credential.Name: confluence
Credential.Description: An API token (id.atlassian.com); set the Confluence account's email as UserName

Messages.400: Confluence rejected the search (400): a filter value may not exist in this site.
Messages.401: Confluence refused the credential (401). The operator should check the email and API token.
Messages.403: Confluence refused this (403): the account cannot see it.
Messages.404: Not found (no such page, or the account cannot see it).

Spaces.Description: Space keys a search may cover (ENG, HR). Searches always name one.

Notes: Set Config.ServerUrl to the site, for example https://acme.atlassian.net, and list that host in Network.Hosts.

Searches are limited to Config.Spaces, but get_page reads any page the account can see by id: use an account that sees only the allowed spaces. Page restrictions are honoured for that account, not for the person asking.
Page text is written by many people: every result taints the caller.
Read only: no creating or editing pages, no comments.

search_pages.Description: Search pages in one space by words, newest change first.

text.Description: Words to look for in titles and page text.

title.Description: Words to look for in titles only.

modified_since.Description: Changed on or after this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

get_page.Description: Read one page by id (from search_pages) as plain text.
